intro: The analysis below summarizes candidate reports for the SSC CGL 2026 Tier 1 exam held on 11 October 2026. Shifts 1 and 3 have reported data, while Shift 2 is only partially reported and therefore lacks a usable analysis at this time. All figures are unofficial and the SSC normalises scores across shifts. The information reflects the range of perceptions among test takers and does not constitute an official difficulty rating.
